info.name: Cisco NX-API REST Authentication VLANs API
Create or Modify a Vlan Bridge Domain

items.docs: Creates or modifies VLAN bridge domains using the bdEntity container with l2BD child objects. The fabEncap attribute specifies the VLAN ID in the format vlan-{id}. Supports VLAN naming and pcTag assignment.

info.name: Retrieve a Specific Vlan Bridge Domain

params.name: vlanEncap
params.description: VLAN fabric encapsulation identifier in the format vlan-{id} (e.g., vlan-100)

params.name: rsp-subtree
params.description: Controls the depth of child objects returned in the response. no returns the target MO only. children includes direct children. full includes the complete subtree.

params.name: rsp-prop-include
params.description: Controls which properties are included in the response. all returns all properties. config-only returns only configurable properties. set-config-only returns only properties that have been explicitly set.

items.docs: Returns the configuration and state of a specific VLAN bridge domain identified by its fabric encapsulation (e.g., vlan-100). Use rsp-subtree=full to include child objects like VLAN member ports and statistics.
Removes a VLAN bridge domain from the switch configuration. This operation also removes any associated SVI and port membership configurations.

params.name: query-target-filter
params.description: Filter expression using conditions like eq(property,"value"), ne(property,"value"), gt, lt, ge, le, wcard, and boolean operators and, or, not

params.name: rsp-prop-include
params.description: Controls which properties are included in the response. all returns all properties. config-only returns only configurable properties. set-config-only returns only properties that have been explicitly set.

params.name: page-size
params.description: Number of objects to return per page for class-level queries

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated class-level queries (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns all l2BD managed objects representing configured VLANs on the switch. Supports filtering by VLAN name, encapsulation, or administrative state.

params.name: sviId
params.description: SVI identifier in the format vlan{id} (e.g., vlan100)

params.name: rsp-subtree
params.description: Controls the depth of child objects returned in the response. no returns the target MO only. children includes direct children. full includes the complete subtree.

params.name: rsp-prop-include
params.description: Controls which properties are included in the response. all returns all properties. config-only returns only configurable properties. set-config-only returns only properties that have been explicitly set.

items.docs: Returns the configuration and operational state of a Switch Virtual Interface (SVI) identified by its VLAN ID (e.g., vlan100). SVIs provide Layer 3 routing capability for VLANs.

info.name: Create or Modify an Svi (vlan Interface)

params.name: sviId
params.description: SVI identifier in the format vlan{id}

items.docs: Creates or modifies a Switch Virtual Interface (SVI) for Layer 3 routing on a VLAN. Requires the interface-vlan feature to be enabled (fmInterfaceVlan adminSt=enabled). Properties include admin state, description, MTU, bandwidth, MAC address, and medium type.
